provenance.source: Square Reporting API (MCP-SIM), view ProductMixReport, measures net_sales (ex-VAT) + items_sold_quantity, dims location_name+category_name+item_name+local_date
provenance.note: Held-out ITEM-grain (L3) June actuals. Active venues only (TRT closed all June, Events out of brain scope). NEVER written to served store. Category-sum reconciles to the L2 pull (max diff GBP 0.00); Square Uncategorized kept verbatim (taxonomy map applies Uncategorised at read time). Null item is a Square category-level residual row (no item name) and routes to that category OTHER.
provenance.unit: GBP ex-VAT net sales + units per venue/category/item/local date
